name: Toba Ayame
source:
Ayame is the an old friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url]. For showing her respect toward her, she call her [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio-Sama[/url].

[spoiler]She comes from an old and noble family who mastered the ninja arts. Currently, she knows how to fight with anything. That's why she always walks around with a thick dictionary.[/spoiler]
translation:
Ayame is the an old friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url]. For showing her respect toward her, she call her [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio-Sama[/url].

[spoiler]She comes from an old and noble family who mastered the ninja arts. Currently, she knows how to fight with anything. That's why she always walks around with a thick dictionary.[/spoiler]
